profile: Silkeborg IF Invest A/S, now renamed Papirfabrikken Invest A/S, holds the remaining 20% stake in Silkeborg IF A/S after selling a majority of the football business in 2024. The company also owns and develops commercial property at Papirfabrikken in Silkeborg and operates Hotel Papirfabrikken Radisson Blu, including hotel and conference services.
